essence: Tārā and Tripurasundarī are both counted among the great knowledges.
Tvaritā, Annapūrṇā, and Vāgvādinī are included among the enumerated goddesses.
Dhūmāvatī, Bhairavī, and Pratyaṅgirā with others complete this enumeration.
Recitation of these goddesses' mantras causes the breaking of sleep.
There is no harm in their recitation and worship; it becomes progressively superior.
